failures.question: How many orders does each customer have with status 'cancelled'? Show customer name and count.
failures.gold_sql: SELECT c.name, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'cancelled' GROUP BY c.customer_id ORDER BY order_count DESC
failures.pred_sql:
SELECT c.name, COUNT(o.order_id) AS cancelled_order_count
FROM customers c
LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id AND o.status = 'cancelled'
GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name
ORDER BY c.customer_id;

failures.gold_sql: SELECT t.ticket_id, c.name AS customer_name, e.name AS employee_name FROM support_tickets t JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = t.customer_id LEFT JOIN employees e ON e.employee_id = t.assigned_employee_id WHERE t.priority = 'urgent'
failures.pred_sql:
SELECT st.ticket_id, c.name, e.name, st.priority
FROM support_tickets st
JOIN customers c ON st.customer_id = c.customer_id
LEFT JOIN employees e ON st.assigned_employee_id = e.employee_id
WHERE st.priority = 'urgent'

failures.question: Show the top 5 customers by total spend on delivered orders.

FROM customers c
